summary: Frontend-only regression for new content hubs completed on localhost. Homepage, listing/detail hubs, utility hubs, mobile sticky bars, and route availability validated successfully.
action_items: No blocking fixes required from this test run.
Optional hardening: treat unknown hub slugs as 404 instead of fallback-to-first-item for cleaner SEO behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code-quality or testability blockers found in reviewed hub files.
Interactive and critical UI elements reviewed in scope include data-testid coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated routes: /, /blog, /blog/how-to-read-newspaper-for-clat, /courses, /courses/clat-two-year-program, /faculties(+detail), /branches(+detail), /toppers(+detail), /testimonials(+detail), /results, /events, /scholarships, /resources, /faqs. Mobile checks passed at 390 and 360 with no horizontal overflow and sticky bar tap working.
rca of the issue: No product defect reproduced in this scope. Large REQUEST FAILED net::ERR_ABORTED lines in automation console log are consistent with rapid dev-server route/module aborts during scripted navigations and were non-blocking; all target routes returned HTTP 200 and rendered expected content.
